text:
maria: Heads up — seeing what I'm calling 'row grafting' between workspaces in the console table. Quick-switching shows runs from the previous org mixed into the active view. Not obvious data corruption, but clearly UI showing wrong rows. :eyes:
jonathan: repro steps? browser / steps?
maria: repro in prod reliably when I quick-switch orgs within ~200–400ms. Steps: open /console/runs for org-A, click quick-switch to org-B via the header, keep the Runs list open. Sometimes rows from org-A remain interleaved with org-B rows.
sahil: can you capture a network trace? suspect a stale routing header or prefetch race.
maria: here's a minimal capture: request: `GET /api/runs?limit=50&cursor=abc123`
headers:
  cookie: session=eyJ...; workspace=org-A
  x-rw-org: org-B
  accept: application/json
response 200, body contains runs with workspace: org-A and org-B mixed in the same page
anya: if x-rw-org != cookie.workspace we're hitting a mismatch between auth context and telemetry/routing header. The listing service picks the workspace from the cookie if present (legacy behaviour), but console sets x-rw-org for client routing. There's a race when both are updated asynchronously.
jonathan: ugh. That's a classic client+proxy state mismatch. Any recent changes to prefetch or header sync?
deploy-bot: deploy: eng-platform v3.4.9 -> prod by ci/cd at 2509876400
sahil: v3.4.9 included async prefetch for quick-switch. Likely the client updates x-rw-org first, then the cookie is set via an insecure path and lags. Server-side code still prefers cookie.workspace over x-rw-org.
maria: immediate impact — UI shows mixed rows for users doing rapid switches. Not sure if any sensitive cross-org data was exposed beyond UI mixing, but need to assume possible.
jonathan: mitigation: 1) hotfix middleware to prefer authoritative org from auth token/session if available, fall back to x-rw-org only if consistent. 2) disable client prefetch on quick-switch until we have atomic consistency. Rollout can be canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
sahil: I'll open a PR for middleware check: `if (auth.org && header.org && auth.org != header.org) { invalidateCache(); forceReauth(); emitEvent('org_mismatch'); }` PR: #4321
anya: also add a short-lived feature-flag to flip prefetch off in prod quickly if needed.
jonathan: add telemetry event `org_mismatch` with sample=100% for the first hour after deploy and create an alert: `org_mismatch_rate > 0.1%` -> pager to eng-platform.
maria: I'm going to ping CS to see if any customers reported confusing mixed results. Will also add a short blameless note to #incidents if we confirm exposure.
sahil: ETA: can land PR + tests today, request a quick QA pass (integration with cookie/header consistency) and then patch deploy. Rollout plan: canary EU 5% at 2509880000, expand to NA 50% next hour.
jonathan: good. add rollback: if org_mismatch_rate spikes after the fix (meaning we regressed), revert middleware and re-enable prefetch toggle off.
maria: thanks team. I'll monitor live and keep CS looped in. :thumbsup:
